page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-180 is a general-purpose server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 180 vCPUs derived from 90 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor, utilizing multithreading with two threads per core. The instance is equipped with 720 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes.

In performance evaluations, the c3d-standard-180 demonstrates top-tier multi-core capabilities, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core testing and Geekbench multi-core scores. Its memory subsystem is highly efficient, achieving top-tier status in small-block cached read bandwidth at 13,454.22 GB/sec and strong large-block uncached read/write speeds. Cryptographic and vector processing are accelerated by hardware support for AVX-512 and AES instructions, reflected in top-tier Passmark CPU extended instructions and encryption scores.

This instance is highly optimized for scale-out workloads, software compilation, and database operations, as evidenced by its top-tier Redis SET performance of 211.43 million operations per second. It also exhibits strong capabilities in LLM inference, particularly for medium and large models. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPUs represents a tradeoff for workloads requiring direct-attached high-speed disk I/O or hardware-accelerated graphics processing. It is best suited for high-density general-purpose applications, large-scale web serving, and parallelized CPU-bound tasks.
